app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: Telemetry metrics scraping failed because the OpenTelemetry Collector agent's kubeletstats receiver could not validate the kubelet TLS certificate for node IP 172.18.0.6. Collector log messages show: "Get \"https://172.18.0.6:10250/stats/summary\": tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: cannot validate certificate for 172.18.0.6 because it doesn't contain any IP SANs". This causes metric collection degradation for the telemetry pipeline. The collector also logged DNS resolution errors ("lookup firepit on 10.96.0.10:53: server misbehaving"), indicating an intermittent cluster DNS problem, but the concrete failure preventing kubelet stats scraping is the kubelet certificate missing IP SANs.
